name: What is a contingency fund in construction budgeting and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is a contingency fund in construction budgeting and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contingency fund is a dedicated portion of the construction budget set aside for unforeseen expenses or changes that may arise during the project. It acts as a financial buffer against unexpected site conditions, material price fluctuations, or design modifications. Typically, a contingency fund ranges from 10% to 20% of the total project cost. Hometelligent Inc. considers this an essential component of responsible budgeting, preventing delays and financial stress when unexpected issues occur.
